sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Add the missing canonical thrusterIceImpactLoadedAreaEvidence property to the thrusterIceImpactLoadCase shape, with sh:minCount 1 and sh:class nltl:evidenceArtifact, because the COMPLETE dependency contract declares it as a required evidence relationship. Keep it load-case-owned and preserve the existing ship-owned radius conditional, load-case-owned correspondence evidence, table references, operands, units, thruster-body capacity structure, and capacity >= demand direction.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the ownership and conditional path for equivalentImpactSphereRadius. Its authoritative requiredOwner is ship, but the candidate places it on the thrusterIceImpactLoadCase node inside the non-hemispherical branch. Request or locate a canonical cross-owner path that conditionally associates the load case's non-hemispherical classification with the ship-owned radius, and constrain that ship-owned radius to be present only for that branch. Preserve the existing capacity-versus-demand direction and other readiness inputs.

The ship-owned equivalentImpactSphereRadius conditional is now reached through the existing hasThrusterIceImpactLoadCase path, so preserve that ownership and conditional check. Repair two remaining semantic errors: constrain the thruster body reached by thrusterImpactCaseAppliesToBody with a required thrusterResistanceCapacity QuantityValue in KiloN, with decimal qudt:numericValue and the canonical unit, because the current SPARQL comparison does not require or structurally validate the declared result; and move the conditional contactGeometryCorrespondenceEvidence requirement onto the thrusterIceImpactLoadCase owner. The current nested sh:property inside the contactGeometryClassification value alternative targets the controlled contact-geometry value node instead of the load case. Keep the capacity >= demand direction, Table 6-3/6-16 references, operands, speed, loaded-area evidence, and non-hemispherical ship-radius condition.

Repair the contact-geometry conditional at the thrusterIceImpactLoadCase owner. The sh:or branches are nested under the contactGeometryClassification property and therefore constrain the contactGeometryValue node, so both contactGeometryCorrespondenceEvidence and the inverse hasThrusterIceImpactLoadCase/equivalentImpactSphereRadius path target the wrong node and will not enforce the load-case/ship relationship. Preserve the hemispherical versus non-hemispherical alternative, but implement it with a load-case-level conditional (for example, a bounded SHACL SPARQL constraint or equivalent owner-level structure): hemispherical requires no additional branch evidence; non-hemispherical requires load-case-owned contactGeometryCorrespondenceEvidence and the ship-owned equivalentImpactSphereRadius reached through the inverse hasThrusterIceImpactLoadCase path, in metres. Preserve the existing thruster resistance capacity >= impact demand comparison, operands, units, table references, speed, loaded-area evidence, and thruster-body ownership.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: COMPLETE dependency relationship(s) absent from candidate: thrusterIceImpactLoadedAreaEvidence | COMPLEX_READINESS required evidence/method reference(s) absent from candidate: thrusterIceImpactLoadedAreaEvidence
Semantic validator feedback: Add the missing canonical thrusterIceImpactLoadedAreaEvidence property to the thrusterIceImpactLoadCase shape, with sh:minCount 1 and sh:class nltl:evidenceArtifact, because the COMPLETE dependency contract declares it as a required evidence relationship. Keep it load-case-owned and preserve the existing ship-owned radius conditional, load-case-owned correspondence evidence, table references, operands, units, thruster-body capacity structure, and capacity >= demand direction.
